description.from:
## Behavior
As an author, I can scrub a demo, change supported parameters, and copy a working VideoML example.

## Acceptance scenarios
Given a catalog detail page, when parameters or frame position change, then the live preview updates deterministically. Each page includes a reset, copyable XML or TypeScript example, package/import requirements, assets, framework/version support, and links to source. Examples run without Babulus or voice credentials; provide reduced-motion-friendly preview controls.

## Ownership
videoml-org, stdlib, player

## Evidence
Link implementation, runnable fixtures, and verification results before closing. Keep product-boundary decisions in the parent initiative.
